Xerath|mid.identity: Magic damage artillery mage. Arcanopulse (Q) charges up to gain range, Eye of Destruction (W) strikes an area (more damage and a slow in the center), Shocking Orb (E) stuns, and Rite of the Arcane (R) roots him in place to fire several very long-range barrages. His attacks regularly restore mana (passive Mana Surge).
Xerath|mid.playstyle: Pure poke mage with the longest range in the game. Xerath wears down his opponent before they can act and finishes targets from range with his ultimate.
Xerath|mid.early_game: Poke with a charged Q and W (center for big damage) when your opponent comes to last hit. Restore mana with your attacks (passive). Keep E to stun an assassin who engages you.
Xerath|mid.level_2: Eye of Destruction (W). W, then Q on the slowed target: guaranteed poke.
Xerath|mid.level_3: Shocking Orb (E). A stun: your defensive tool. Offensive combo: E → W → Q.
Xerath|mid.level_6: Rite of the Arcane: very long-range barrages. Finish low targets anywhere, including other lanes, or poke before an objective. You're immobile while channeling: stand somewhere safe.
power_spikes: First completed item: very punishing poke.
Mid game: sieging and poking before objectives.
Xerath|mid.lane_plan: Poke constantly and control the wave. Keep E against assassins. Push, then join objectives to poke before fights. The mid role quest (faster recall) helps you reset after emptying your mana.
Xerath|mid.trading: Short trade: W → Q. Defense: E on the incoming assassin. Long-range all-in: E → W → Q → R. Give up on it against assassins who arrive while your E is on cooldown.
threats: Channeling your ultimate within a diver's range.
mistakes: Wasting E and no longer being able to defend yourself.

matchup_notes.Viktor: You outrange him: poke him from outside his laser range.
matchup_notes.Syndra: A range duel: stay out of her stun.
matchup_notes.Ahri: Keep E for her R engage.
matchup_notes.Fizz: He dodges your E: keep it for the end of his hop.
matchup_notes.Locke: He dives you with E: stun him as he arrives.

Xerath|mid.mid_game: Poke before objectives and siege towers.
Xerath|mid.late_game: Artillery behind your frontline: poke, E on the diver, R to finish low targets.
Xerath|mid.ahead: Poke before every objective and take towers.
Xerath|mid.behind: Farm from range and play with your team.
Xerath|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to wear down the enemy team from range before every fight and finish targets with your ultimate.
Xerath|mid.final_tip: Aim for the center of your Eye of Destruction: that's where the damage and slow are highest.
